en: Build your defense above the clouds.
zh_TW: 於雲海之上，築起你的防線。

en: Extend a road above the clouds and shape your defense.
zh_TW: 延伸雲海上的道路，築起屬於你的防線。

en: Defend the bridge above the clouds.

zh_TW: 01 · 選擇地圖   /   02 · 本局設定   /   03 · 開始
01 · 地圖已選   /   02 · 本局設定   /   03 · 開始

en: Preview options · No gameplay effects yet
zh_TW: 暫定選項 · 目前尚未影響戰局

en: Choose a direction for the new entrance

zh_TW: 選擇一個標示的候選位置
選擇期間無法放置防禦塔

en: No forecast change: candidate routes or whole-unit quotas limit this effect
zh_TW: 分流未變：候選路線或整數配額限制

en: No positive-weight route for the next wave
zh_TW: 下一波沒有正權重路線

en: Towers around it can deal more damage.
zh_TW: 強化周圍的防禦塔的攻擊。
對小體型敵人造成更高傷害。

en: Target and hit enemies in the sky.
zh_TW: 能瞄準並擊中空中的敵人。

en: Who doesn't like explosion? it could hit your allies by the way.
zh_TW: 誰不喜歡大爆炸呢? 但小心別炸到友軍。
有冷卻時間的狂轟亂炸。

en: Double damage, but fire only to the right.
zh_TW: 雙倍傷害，但只朝右舷開火。
每 8 秒可處決一名普通敵人。

en: No limit to how high this tower can grow.
Reach farther to lend a hand.
zh_TW: 把火力送到更遠的地方。

en: Hits harder when no other towers are nearby.
zh_TW: 遠離其他防禦塔，才能使出全力。

en: A heavy hit sends enemies backward.
zh_TW: 沉重的箭矢，讓敵人步步後退。

en: There's always room for one more soldier.
zh_TW: 多一名士兵，多一份戰力。

en: No need to wait for enemies to get close.
zh_TW: 不必等敵人靠近，也能出手。

en: All towers and soldiers attack a little faster.
zh_TW: 讓防禦塔與友軍出手更快。
讓防禦塔與友軍打得更痛。

en: A little gold for the road ahead.
A familiar face gets cheaper rerolls.
zh_TW: 熟客優惠，刷新少算一點。

en: Learn camera controls and reshape roads with cards before upgrading your first tower.
zh_TW: 練習鏡頭操作、用卡牌改變道路，再升級你的第一座塔。
左鍵拖曳  /  滾輪  /  右鍵環繞
防線紀錄 / 作戰完成
防線紀錄 / 作戰結束

en:
Left-drag to pan the view.
Use the wheel to zoom.
Right-drag around screen center
to rotate. Try each once.
zh_TW:
按住左鍵拖曳，平移視角。
滾動滾輪，調整遠近。
按住右鍵繞畫面中心拖曳，
旋轉視角。請各試一次。
{pan} 平移　{zoom} 縮放　{orbit} 旋轉

en:
Select the {first_tower} card.
Match the translucent hologram.
The tower blocks the old road;
its card adds a way around it.
zh_TW:
選擇{first_tower}卡。
依半透明指示的方向放置。
塔會占住原路，
附帶道路可讓敵人繞行。

en:
Select the {second_tower} card.
Press R or right-click to rotate.
Match the pulsing hologram
and place your second tower.
zh_TW:
選擇{second_tower}卡。
按 R 或單擊右鍵旋轉，
對齊半透明指示後放置。
讓道路繞過第二座塔。

en:
Place your last {third_tower}.
Choose a position and direction.
Keep the entrance connected
to the goal.
zh_TW:
最後一張{third_tower}可自由放置。
挑選位置與方向，
保持入口到終點連通。

en:
Ready?
Click Start next wave
above the entrance.
zh_TW:
準備好了嗎？
點入口上方的
「開始下一波」。

en:
Watch your towers defend.
After the wave ends,
visit the shop to reinforce.
zh_TW:
觀察防禦塔如何守住道路。
這一波結束後，
再到商店補強。

en:
Open the lower-right shop.
Buy the {upgrade_tower} card.
Use it to upgrade the matching
tower already on the map.
zh_TW:
點開右下角商店，
購買{upgrade_tower}卡。
用它升級地圖上的同種塔。

en:
Place the {upgrade_tower} card
on your existing {upgrade_tower}
to upgrade it to Lv.2.
No extra roads or coins needed.
zh_TW:
把剛買的{upgrade_tower}卡，
放到原本的{upgrade_tower}上，
升級至 Lv.2。
升級不增加道路或額外花費。

en:
Open the shop.
Click its lower-right reroll card
to refresh the offers.
Rerolling costs gold.
zh_TW:
點開商店，
再點右下角的刷新牌。
刷新商品會花費金幣。

en:
Buy {new_tower} from the shop.
Try a tower that was not
in your starting hand.
zh_TW:
購買刷新後的{new_tower}卡，
擴充初始手牌以外的塔種。

en:
The guided steps are complete!
Build and shop freely.
Defend all three waves
to finish the level.
zh_TW:
基本操作練習完成！
接下來可以自由建造，
也能購買與升級。
守完全部三波即可通關。

en:
All three waves cleared!
The next level is now unlocked.
Continue to choose your next battlefield.
zh_TW:
三波防守完成！
後續關卡已解鎖。
繼續選擇下一個戰場吧。

en: Match the highlighted card and hologram position and direction.
zh_TW: 請依提示選牌，並配合半透明指示的位置與方向。

en: Complete the current tutorial step first.
zh_TW: 請先完成目前的教學步驟。

en: Choose an entry to see its details.
Boss: a leak ends the run
A quick-firing watchtower that covers the road ahead of it.
zh_TW: 射速快的基礎防線，守住前方的道路。
單體攻擊|只打前方範圍

en: A heavy bolt thrower with slow, powerful shots along a long line.
zh_TW: 沿長直線射出重箭，射速慢但威力強。

en: Six guns each hold their own straight line, firing on their own timers.
zh_TW: 六門砲各自守住前方直線，獨立計時開火。
六門獨立火砲|只打側舷

en: Releases rapid shockwaves that strike all enemies in range.
zh_TW: 快速釋放衝擊波，打擊範圍內的所有敵人；波次中持續旋轉。

en: Lobs shells that explode on landing. Shells do not track, so enemies can walk out of the blast.
zh_TW: 拋射砲彈，落地時爆炸。砲彈不追蹤，敵人可能走出爆炸範圍。
範圍傷害|無法攻擊飛行敵人

en: Deploys two soldiers who hold enemies on the road and fight them in melee.
zh_TW: 部署兩名友軍在道路上攔截敵人並近戰。

en: Blocks enemies|Soldiers respawn after 5s|Cannot block flying enemies
zh_TW: 攔截敵人|友軍陣亡 5 秒後重生|無法攔截飛行敵人
